 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL ORDER 3 08-10-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.
The petitioner in this application prays for bail apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. C-75 of 2024 registered for the offence under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Both the learned counsel for the petitioner and also learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 submit that there being chance of amicable settlement between the parties, the matter be referred for mediation.

4. The case is referred to the Patna High Court Mediation Centre for mediation where both the petitioner as Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41144 of 2025(3) dt.08-10-2025 also the opposite party no. 2 shall appear on 3.11.2025 at 11:00 a.m.
5.
A report shall be submitted to this Court by the Patna High Court Mediation Centre before the next date.
